signals.summary: Zillow cut just over 500 employees in a company-wide restructuring aimed at a disciplined cost structure and its next phase of growth.
Roughly 200 positions were cut in late January 2026 during annual performance reviews, the first round of layoffs that year.
Q1 2026 revenue rose 18% year over year to $708 million, with net income of $46 million.
Q2 2026 revenue was $772 million, up 18% year over year, with strong mortgage and rentals segment growth.
Zillow posted a $4 million net loss in Q2 2026, though first-half 2026 net income reached $42 million.
CEO says remote-first hiring brought four times the applicants per job versus pre-pandemic, with employee engagement at all-time highs.
